stem:
This excerpt refers to an event that occurred in Virginia in 1859.

A contemporary newspaper account foretold a grim future. “The Harpers Ferry invasion has advanced the cause of disunion more than any other event that has happened since the formation of the Government.”

—“John Brown’s Raid,” National Park Service, www.nps.gov (accessed May 17, 2019)

Which action prompted the newspaper’s claim that John Brown’s raid “advanced the cause of disunion”?

options.label: F
options.text: Some Northerners were willing to defend the South’s right to continue slavery.

options.label: G
options.text: Some Southerners were willing to take up arms to protest high tariffs.

options.label: H
options.text: Some abolitionists thought violence was necessary to end slavery.

options.label: J
options.text: Some people in territories needed to defend their right to popular sovereignty.
